verdicts.reason: EDEN 'BIT 15 OF 0 - 15; ENABLES/DISABLES EDF FEATURE.' with group 12C = ENDTFL07 'ENGINE DATA FILES ENABLE AND POWER-DOWNS', which spells EDF. No test; e2m only. Set. CM848's CHR_CC files have no record at 0x8000 (EDF_Enable is only in the six CHR_B2 files).

0x803cae = 106B +1C = EEPROM 0x1a4; 0x0000 in both dumps. Six absolute reads (0x15830 andi.w #0x2000, 0x15850 andi.w #0x4000, 0x204e6 andi.w #0x80, 0x20cbe and 0x20e5a andi.l #0x80, 0x32ed4 andi.w #0x80) and one address load (23fc 00803cae 0080054c at 0x15dd2); no store, and the pointer users only read. The sampler builds status 0x80bcce / 0x80bccf as (input AND NOT mask) OR (0x80bcd8 / 0x80bcd9 AND mask) with mask [1] / [0], so bit s is logical switch s. The descriptor table at ROM 0x20108 (17 entries of 10 bytes, switch number at +8) gives table bit 0xd0 + s. e2m blocks 106B, 000E (+0 / +1 status, +A / +B values), 12A8 (+s), 12FC and 1234 (bit s) name the same function for every switch. CM848's word 13 has four unrelated records, so cm550_ is right.

No record with mask 0x1 at 106B +1C in v64t6_s (nor a 12A8 / 12FC / 1234 record for switch 0), so the name rests on code: mask byte [1] covers all eight bits of status byte 0x80bcce, and its bit 0 is the key switch (000E +0 DSKYSWSS S mask 0x1; cm550_updateEngineState and mc68k_runPowerDownSequence read it as the key). The effect of the bit is proved, so a name is allowed. Clear.

DSCRRUUO and DS01SWUO S mask 0x2 ('CRUISE CONTROL RESUME SWITCH' in the 4 uncut files); 000E DSRUSWSS 0x2, 12A8 +1 DSPZCRRU; descriptor entry 6 (0x80d716, SPN 601) holds switch 1 = table bit 209. Clear.
DSCRSEUO and DS02SWUO S mask 0x4; 000E DSSESWSS 0x4, 12A8 +2 DSPZCRSE; descriptor entry 7 (0x80d717, SPN 599) holds switch 2 = table bit 210. Clear.
DSCRONUO and DS03SWUO S mask 0x8 ('CC/PTO ON/OFF SWITCH'); 000E DSCRSWSS 0x8, 12A8 +3 DSPZCRON; descriptor entry 5 (0x80d715, SPN 596) holds switch 3 = table bit 211. Clear.
DSMNFNUO, DSFACLUO and DS05SWUO S mask 0x10; 000E DSFMSW 0x10 'MANUAL FAN INPUT SWITCH', 12A8 +4 DSPZFMIP. e2m plus the byte mask [1]. Clear.

DSHSDPUO and DS07SWUO S mask 0x40 'HSG DROOP SELECT SWITCH'; 000E HSDRSLSW 0x40, 12A8 +6 DSPZHGSW. e2m plus the byte mask [1]. Clear.

DSNTIVUO and DS09SWUO S mask 0x100 'RAW NOT IDLE SWITCH INPUT'; 000E +1 DSIVNTSW 0x1, 12A8 +8 NOT_IDLE_SWITCH; mask byte [0] bit 0. Clear.

DSOVAISW (text cut after 'WORD 13 BIT 9') and DS10SWUO S mask 0x200; 12A8 +9 DSPZAISW, 12FC DSGDAISW 0x200 and 1234 DSINAISW 0x200 all say ACCELERATOR INTERLOCK; descriptor entry 1 (0x80d710, SPN 972) holds switch 9 = table bit 217. Clear.
DSCHSWUO and DS11SWUO S mask 0x400; 000E +1 DSCHSWSS 0x4; descriptor entry 4 (0x80d713, SPN 598) holds switch 10 = table bit 218. Clear.
DSBRSWUO and DS12SWUO S mask 0x800; 000E +1 DSBRSWSS 0x8; descriptor entry 3 (0x80d712, SPN 597) holds switch 11 = table bit 219. Clear.
DSEBUO01, DSOVEBSW and DS13SWUO S mask 0x1000; 000E +1 DSEBS1 / EGBKSW 0x10, 12A8 +C DSPZEBS1; CM848's switch 12 is the same Engine_Brake_Select_1 record. e2m plus the byte mask [0]. Clear.

DSICSWUO and DS14SWUO S mask 0x2000; 000E +1 DSICSWSS 0x20; descriptor entry 9 (0x80d71b, SPN 968) holds switch 13 = table bit 221; andi.w #0x2000 at 0x15830 puts status bit 0x20 back from 0x80bcd9 after the decode from the cruise switches. Clear.
DSDTSWUO and DS15SWUO S mask 0x4000; 000E +1 DSDTSWSS 0x40; descriptor entry 8 (0x80d718, SPN 967) holds switch 14 = table bit 222; andi.w #0x4000 at 0x15850 does the same for status bit 0x40. Clear.
DSTESWUO and DS16SWUO S mask 0x8000; 000E +1 DSTESWSS 0x80; descriptor entry 15 (0x80d724, SPN 966) holds switch 15 = table bit 223. Clear.

0x803cb0 = 106B +1E = EEPROM 0x1a6; 0x0000 in both dumps. One absolute reference: 0x207d0 move.w + andi.l #0x8 + beq.w, after word 18 andi.l #0x1000 at 0x207c0; none to 0x803cb1, no store. Mask bytes [3] / [2] cover status bytes 0x80bcd0 / 0x80bcd1 with values 0x80bcda / 0x80bcdb, so bit n is logical switch 16 + n; descriptor entries 14 / 13 hold switches 19 / 20 = table bits 227 / 228. CM848 has no row, no record at +001E in any CHR file and no reference to 0x3fd5b8 (0x0000 in its dump). The five switch_N names use the e2m's own switch numbers (DS17 / 27 / 28 / 23 / 31SWUO), which differ from the logical index for four of them; the comments say so.

DS17SWUO S mask 0x1 is the only record; 000E +2 0x1, 12A8 +10, 12FC and 1234 0x10000 also carry only the generic SWITCH 17 records; no read of 0x80bcd0 bit 0 in the .cpp or by absolute address. The name says what is proved. Clear.

DSAKTKUO and DS18SWUO S mask 0x2; 12A8 +11 DSPZACPT, 12FC DSDFACTK 0x20000 and 1234 DSINACPT 0x20000 say AC PRESSURE TURNKEY SWITCH; code copies 0x80bcd0 bit 1 into 0x80bcd7 bit 0 (000E +9 DSAKPRSW). Clear.

DSRMTHUO and DS20SWUO S mask 0x8; 000E +2 RMTHSW 0x8; descriptor entry 14 (0x80d723, SPN 969) holds switch 19 = table bit 227; direct andi.l #0x8 at 0x207d0 gates the J1939 remote accelerator position into analog_sensor_override_values[11]. Clear.
DSRXSWUO and DS21SWUO S mask 0x10; 000E +2 DSRXSWSS 0x10; descriptor entry 13 (0x80d721) holds switch 20 = table bit 228. Clear.

DSPRBRUO and DS24SWUO S mask 0x80. The record's own text is the manual fan's (in all 27 files that have it), but 000E +C DSPRBRUC 0x80, 12A8 +17 DSPZPRBR and 1234 DSPRBRIV 0x800000 all say parking brake for this switch; the one counter-witness is 12FC DSDFPRBR at 0x80000, as the notes say. The 76-character name is a fair reading; no rule limits length. Clear.

DS27SWUO S mask 0x400 is the only 106B record; the other blocks disagree for switch 26 (12A8 +1A / 12FC air conditioner pressure, 1234 DSINACHP AC high pressure) and descriptor entry 0 puts the J1939 A/C pressure switch at switch 72. Keeping the e2m switch number is the cautious choice. Clear.

DS28SWUO S mask 0x800 plus DSAKHIUO and DSTHILUO (group BD MUX_PARA). Every block gives switch 27 both alias sets (AC high pressure and throttle interlock), while the ROM routes the J1939 accelerator interlock to switch 9. Undecided is right. Clear.

DS23SWUO S mask 0x1000 is the only 106B record in v64t6_s; 12A8 +1C DSPZEBS2 and 12FC DSDFEBS2 suggest engine brake select 2 (8 other files have DSEBUO02 here, 21 have DSOROESW OEM_SWITCH). Guess kept in the comment, as it should be. Clear.

DSAKONUO and DS30SWUO S mask 0x4000; 000E +D DSAKONUC 0x40 'AC_ON_OFF_SWITCH', 12A8 +1E DSPZACOO, 12FC DSDFACOO, 1234 DSACOOIV. e2m plus the byte mask [2]. Clear.
DS31SWUO S mask 0x8000 is the only record in every block; status bit unread. Clear.

CM848's own e2m (CHR_CC_11.45.01.07) has Overspeed_FSO_Override at 106B +001A, S mask 2: '[EPOSFSO] If T, FSO closes when ovrspd detected by main micro. Bit 1 of 0 - 15 of Word C'. CM848's .cpp never prints algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal.reserved_bit_1 (11 other fields of the word render), so the rename is label-only. fuel_shutoff is CM848's existing spelling of FSO (fault_bit_words_t.fuel_shutoff_control_error). 'enable' for the label's 'Override' matches the record's text and CM550's reader at 0x1ca9a, and equals the CM550 field.

overall:
No bit position, mask, address, EEPROM offset or dump value in W2 moves, no word is written, and nothing is refuted: 106 CONFIRMED, 14 AMENDED. One amendment changes a field name (word 12 bit 9), one carries a row comment fix plus the type name judgment the proposer flagged (word 7), the other twelve are comment fixes (eight of them the same count in word 9's documentation-only bits).

How it was checked (from scratch; scripts in /home/linux/.claude/jobs/374b0424/tmp/w15/r92/scratch/W2/skeptic/): my own CPU32 disassembler (m68k.py; llvm-mc-18 mis-decodes andi / tst here), a scan of the ROM for every 32-bit operand in the block at any byte offset (absrefs.py), the raw v64t6_s records with their masks (raw106b.py, blockmasks.py), all 36 ISB and 23 CHR e2m files (survey.py, countfiles.py), both dumps at word width (dumps.py), CM848's CSVs, e2m and RAM dump. The verdict list was built and checked by build_verdict_W2.py (120 elements, each quoted 'replace' string occurs exactly once in the proposal text it amends).

What holds: 30 references to 0x803ca2-0x803cb1, all at even offsets: 29 x move.w (abs).l,d0 followed by andi.w / andi.l with one bit, and the one address load at 0x15dd2. No reference to words 9 / 10, to an odd address, to the EEPROM form 0x01000198-0x010001a7, or off the mirror base; no other register is loaded with a block address. All 15 indexed sites are movea.l #0x803c94,a0 + move.w (0,a0,dn.w*2) reads with word = bit / 16 and mask = 1 shifted left by bit mod 16. Dumps: 0xffff / 0 / 0 / 0x000b / 0xbb87 / 0 / 0, EEPROM = RAM. Two things back the nine protection channels beyond what the proposal cites: the input pointers are set by ROM code (vp44_engineProtectionSystemInit 0x1873e), not only seen in the dump, and e2m 10B3 +0 EPSOAE lists 'C. LEV. = 0, C. TEMP. = 1, IMT = 2, OIL PRESS. = 3'. The 32 switch bits follow from the sampler's own byte masks and agree across five e2m blocks (106B, 000E, 12A8, 12FC, 1234) and the J1939 descriptor table at ROM 0x20108.

The amendments: (1) word 12 bit 9: 'zero under load' is CM848's code wording; CM550 has only VSSTEN 'lost while stopped' and no reader, so the name becomes vehicle_speed_sensor_lost_while_stopped_detection_enable (bit 8 may take the parallel 'lost_while_moving_detection' name; its present name is not wrong). (2) word 7: the direct test is the start-up fueling derate (EPFLSRTM = CM848 Fueling_Startup_Derate_Time), not an inhibit; and, separately, the type can be the unprefixed algorithm_enable_flags_7_t because no bit differs from CM848. (3) word 7 bit 14: the evaluator skips channel 3. (4) counts: EPOE* / EPOS* are in 18 files not 20 (word 9 bits 4-11), JCRWDXEN in 13 not 14 (word 11 bit 4), the OBD fault handler mask 0x400 in 28 not 26 (word 12 bit 10), LSCIIHEN '- BIT 14' in 9 not 13 (word 12 bit 14).

Corrections to the notes, outside the elements: EPWF / EPBS / EPFP / EPAA are in 27 files, not 33. The read at 0x1cd96 is followed by sne d0, not a branch. AD25OD (the word 20 aside; the test at 0x20fd8 is real, andi.w #0x200) is in 5 other files, not six. The notes count 15 indexed sites but describe only the protection loops and cm550_FUN_00020890; the fifteenth, at 0x206e6, is cm550_FUN_000206a8, called five times from cm550_FUN_00021070 with switches 54 / 54 / 33 / 32 / 54, so it reaches words 15 / 16 only and nothing in this batch. PTBRODEN / PTCHODEN: 4 other ISB files keep the letter and 18 ISB + 16 CHR_CC files carry the mask.

For the orchestrator: word 13 bits 1 / 2 and W3's word 16 bits 0 / 2 share two field names; word 13's are the ones their own records back (DSCRRUUO / DSCRSEUO), so if one pair moves it should be W3's. Word 12 bits 7 / 8 / 9 / 11 / 12 / 13 / 15 are named from the e2m alone (no reader in the dumped 256 KB). The CM848 rename is label-only in its .cpp.
